index.title: CleanU · Safe, transparent macOS menu bar disk cleanup
index.description: CleanU is a macOS menu bar disk cleanup app. Read-only scans cover caches, temporary files, developer tool caches, project artifacts, app leftovers, installers, archives, and large files. Review the items and confirm before cleanup. A single universal DMG supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 15 or later.
index.intro: CleanU scans caches, temporary files, developer tool caches, project artifacts, app leftovers, installers, archives, and large files. It groups the results into cache cleanup, project cleanup, app leftovers, and storage analysis. Each item shows its path and size. Cleanup starts only after you confirm.
index.altScanning: CleanU scanning for items you can clean up
index.altReview: CleanU scan results ready for review
index.altSelected: CleanU scan results with items selected
index.featureIntro: One scan shows what you can clean up and how much space each item takes up.
index.featureScanBody: A single deep scan groups the results into cache cleanup, project cleanup, app leftovers, and storage analysis.
index.featureReviewBody: Every item shows its full path and actual size. You can select items individually for cleanup.
index.safetyReadBody: Scanning reads only directories and file attributes. It never writes, moves, or deletes any files.
index.safetyConfirmBody: Candidates are cleaned only after you explicitly confirm. There is no automatic background cleanup.
index.safetyCheckBody: Candidates are checked again before cleanup. Any item whose path or size no longer matches is excluded.
index.safetyTrashBody: After you confirm, files move to the Trash, where you can restore them if needed.
index.safetyPermissionsBody: CleanU runs with the current user’s permissions and never asks for an administrator password. Unreadable paths do not appear in the results.
index.pricingIntro: Try it first. If it’s right for you, buy it outright.
index.pricingUpdatesBody: All future version updates are free with a one-time purchase.
index.pricingDevicesBody: Use one license on up to two of your own Macs at a time. Before switching to a new Mac, deactivate the license on the old one.
index.faqStorage: How is this different from System Settings → General → Storage?
index.faqStorageBody: System Settings shows how much space each category uses, but offers limited options for cleaning up individual items. CleanU puts all eight types in one list (caches, temporary files, developer tool caches, project artifacts, app leftovers, installers, archives, and large files). Each item shows its full path and size. Items move to the Trash only after you select and confirm them.
index.faqAccess: Why does CleanU need Full Disk Access?
index.faqAccessBody: Without this permission, macOS limits access to some directories, so scan results may be incomplete and some sources may appear empty. Full Disk Access lets CleanU read caches and artifacts in those locations. CleanU uses this permission only to read files. It runs with your existing user permissions and does not require an administrator password.
index.faqDeletion: Could CleanU accidentally remove files that are still in use?
index.faqDeletionBefore: CleanU cleans up only the items you select and confirm. It checks them again and skips anything whose path or size has changed. Files go to the Trash, where you can restore them. If you remove project artifacts (for example,
index.faqDeletionAfter: ), you will need to reinstall the project’s dependencies before it can run again.
index.faqUpload: Will it upload my files or data?
index.faqUploadBody: No. Scanning, reviewing, and cleanup all happen on your Mac. Every item in the list corresponds to a real path on disk. Cleaned files go to the Trash.
index.pricingTrialBody: The trial gives you access to every feature without an account. To keep using CleanU after the trial, you’ll need to buy and activate a license. We don’t offer refunds if you change your mind or don’t use the app.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy · CleanU
privacy.description: Learn how the CleanU macOS app and website handle local data, license requests, and information about site visits.
privacy.intro: This policy applies to the CleanU macOS app and website. It explains how we handle local file information, license requests, and data about your visits to the site.
privacy.scopeBody: During a scan, CleanU reads directories, file paths, and file attributes on your Mac to find items you can clean up and calculate their sizes. Scanning, review, and cleanup all happen on your Mac. The app does not upload file contents, scan results, or cleanup history. CleanU does not require an account and does not include in-app advertising or analytics SDKs.
privacy.networkBody: When you check for updates, CleanU goes online to get version information. It does not upload scan results or cleanup history. Your browser stores your theme preference and the latest CleanU version you’ve seen on the homepage. The website uses this information to apply your theme and show you when a newer version is available. The website does not use ads or third-party analytics. When you visit the website, check for updates, or make a purchase, the relevant services may receive routine connection information such as your IP address. See their privacy policies for details.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: When you use services from Dodo Payments, GitHub, or Cloudflare, their privacy policies apply to the data they process.
privacy.contactBodyBefore: For questions about this policy or data handling, contact us through the
privacy.changesBody: If the app or website changes how it handles data, we will update the date and information on this page.
privacy.licenseBody: Dodo Payments processes payments and sends license emails. When you first activate CleanU, the app sends your license key and a randomly generated installation ID to Dodo Payments. After activation, the app runs automatic online license checks at regular intervals. For verification or deactivation, it sends the license key and the activation ID issued by Dodo Payments. These requests do not include scan results, file paths, or cleanup history.
privacy.keychainBody: Trial and license records are stored in your Mac’s Keychain and are not synced through iCloud. Reinstalling CleanU does not remove them. To free a license slot, deactivate the license in the app on that Mac and wait for confirmation.

checkout.title: Purchase & Activation · CleanU
checkout.description: Check your purchase email and activate your license in CleanU.
checkout.heading: Next, activate your license in the app
checkout.neutral: Look for a message from Dodo Payments in the email account you used at checkout. Follow the steps below to get and activate your license. This page cannot confirm whether your order is complete.
checkout.succeeded: The payment service reported a successful payment. Check your Dodo Payments purchase email and the activation status in the app. This page does not independently verify your order.
checkout.processing: The payment service says the payment is still processing. Wait for the purchase email. If you have been charged, do not pay again.
checkout.failed: The payment service says the payment did not complete. If you were charged, contact purchase support before trying to pay again.
checkout.cancelled: The payment service says the payment was canceled. If you have not paid, you can return to pricing. If you were charged, contact support before trying again.
checkout.unknown: This page can’t determine your order status. Check your email and payment records to avoid paying twice.
checkout.stepEmail: Look for the Dodo Payments email in the account you used at checkout. If it’s missing, check your spam folder too.
checkout.stepApp: Install the latest version of CleanU that supports license activation, then open License Management from the menu bar icon’s context menu.
checkout.stepActivate: Copy the full license key from the email and use it to activate CleanU on this Mac. You’ll need an internet connection the first time you activate. Activation won’t start a scan or cleanup.
checkout.authority: Messages on this page, order details in the URL, and links can’t unlock the app.
checkout.helpTitle: Missing an email or switching Macs?
checkout.helpBody: If you were charged but did not receive an email, check your spam folder, then look up the order in the Dodo Payments customer portal below. If you cannot sign in, entered the wrong email address at checkout, or still cannot find the order, contact Dodo Payments through its official support page.
checkout.purchaseChannel: Once you receive your purchase email, use its support link if you were charged twice, reached the activation limit, lost your old Mac, or have another activation issue. Share only the email address you used to buy CleanU, the necessary order details, and a brief description of the issue. Never post license keys or payment details in public GitHub Issues.

terms.trialBody: Click “Start Trial” to use all CleanU features free for 30 days. No account is required. After the trial, purchase and activate a license to continue using CleanU.

If a license is revoked under applicable law or payment platform rules, it becomes invalid. Dodo Payments shows the taxes, payment currency, and final total at checkout.
terms.devicesBody: You may use one license on up to two of your own Macs at the same time. Do not resell or share it. Deactivate the old Mac before switching. Switching macOS user accounts, using a virtual machine, or reinstalling after losing local license records may count as an additional activation.
